summary: Fans spotted Travis Kelce wearing a beaded friendship bracelet reading "Vigilante S***", a reference to a Taylor Swift song, at a charity event two days before Swift attended his Kansas City Chiefs game. Swift cheered from the box seats at Arrowhead Stadium and reportedly joined Kelce at a post-game party. The article also recounts Kelce's comments on dating rumours and his earlier failed attempt to give Swift a bracelet with his number.
one_line: Fans noticed Travis Kelce wearing a Taylor Swift-themed "Vigilante S***" friendship bracelet days before Swift attended his Chiefs game amid dating rumours.
key_facts: A TikTok video posted on 25 September showed Travis Kelce wearing a beaded friendship bracelet reading "Vigilante S***".
The photo was taken at the Kelce Car Jam charity event on Friday 22 September.
"Vigilante S***" is a song from Taylor Swift's 2022 album Midnights.
In other photos from the charity event, shared on Instagram by Jordan's KC photography, Kelce was not wearing the bracelet, so many believed he got it from a fan that day.
Taylor Swift sat next to Kelce's mother, Donna, at Arrowhead Stadium and appeared to yell "let's f***ing go" after Kelce's third-quarter touchdown reception.
The Kansas City Chiefs beat the Chicago Bears 41-10 in the game.
After the game Kelce wore a blue and white splatter-paint denim suit, which fans took as a nod to Swift's 1989 (Taylor's Version), due for re-release on 27 October.
Kelce reportedly rented out Prime Social Rooftop in Kansas City for a post-game celebration; per a witness quoted by Entertainment Tonight, the party lasted until 2 am.
On The Pat McAfee Show on 21 September, Kelce mocked his brother Jason Kelce for saying he "100 per cent" believed Travis was dating Swift, comparing the rumours to "a game of telephone".
Kelce said he had "threw the ball in her court" by suggesting Swift come see him "rock the stage in Arrowhead".
In July, Kelce said he tried and failed to give Swift a friendship bracelet with his number on it at an Eras Tour concert.
Kelce said Swift does not talk before or after shows because she saves her voice for the 44 songs she sings.
